versions.name: Skating
versions.description: Stroke, glide, crossover and stop on ice skates, roller skates, in-line skates or a skateboard, learning how the equipment is built and cared for and how to share a rink or park safely.

provenance.notes: Introduction year (and BSA number where absent) backfilled from the USSSP merit badge history table; for a renamed badge this is when THIS name took effect, not when the lineage began.
